sloka: तथैव अंशुमता वत्स लोके अप्रतिम तेजसा ।गंगाम् प्रार्थयता नेतुम् प्रतिज्ञा न अपवर्जिता ॥१-४४-९॥
transliteration: tathaiva aṁśumatā vatsa loke apratima tejasā ।gaṁgām prārthayatā netum pratijñā na apavarjitā ॥1-44-9॥

translations.english: O Child similarly though Anshuman possessed unparalleled prowess in this world his prayer to Ganga, his vow could not be fulfilled.
